1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening is formed by removing at least a portion of a solder mask layer to expose an underlying core layer; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to both a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening, and wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface to increase lid or ring thickness and contact area to improve package coplanarity.

7. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a lid or a ring that is bonded to both the bottom surface and the sidewall of the opening.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure includes a lid, and wherein the lid is bonded to both the bottom surface and the sidewall of the opening to increase lid thickness and contact area.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, wherein the lid extends above the chip mounting surface.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring bonded to both the bottom surface and the sidewall of the opening, and wherein the ring extends above the chip mounting surface to increase ring thickness and contact area.

11. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the ground reference plane layer is in contact with the stiffening microstructure, and wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to both the bottom surface and the sidewall of the opening.

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening is formed by removing at least a portion of a solder mask layer to expose an underlying core layer; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to both a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening, and wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface to increase lid or ring thickness and contact area to improve package coplanarity.
